title: ID0477311-DC/Si-D/GB- [MP / P1 170000136] Charging limited to 22kW
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Charging is limited to 22kW in all outlets
Solution: SmartCharging profile was added -> Removed

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477311-DC/Si-D/GB- [MP / P1 170000136] Power Supply Issue CRM:03289000499
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Stonier,
I hope you are doing well. Thank you for raising the issue.
From your supplied log, if you scroll bit right you can see how much EV is requesting. Its EV is requesting 22,170W (around 22KW) and Charger is supplying accordingly. Please see below:
The EV is currently drawing 22 kW, which is typical for a 22 kW AC charger or for a DC charging phase where the EV requests lower power (often at low SoC or battery temperature).
But the log itself shows no charger‑side limitation.
Let me know, this answer your question. A quick feedback will help me to close the ticket.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
